name: Virtual Assets for Terrorist Financing
description: Terrorist supporters may solicit and move small to moderate amounts through virtual assets, using self-hosted wallets, privacy-enhanced assets, mixers or decentralised services. Risks are driven by pseudonymity and cross-border speed, balanced against traceability on public blockchains.

sources.text: FATF, Targeted Update on Implementation of the FATF Standards on Virtual Assets and VASPs (annual since 2019)
FATF, Updated Guidance for a Risk-Based Approach to Virtual Assets and Virtual Asset Service Providers (2021)

exposure.rationale: Self-hosted wallets, mixers, P2P exchanges, fiat on and off-ramps.

indicators.name: Deposits from or withdrawals to wallets attributed to terrorist fundraising
indicators.canon: Exposure to wallets attributed to designated, stolen-fund or illicit actors
indicators.desc: Customer transacts directly or near-directly with blockchain addresses attributed by sanctions lists or analytics to designated persons, thefts, ransomware or terrorist fundraising.
indicators.ctx: On-chain analytics link counterparty addresses to published designations or documented fundraising campaigns.
indicators.fp: Attribution can be incorrect or outdated; shared services create indirect exposure.

indicators.name: Retail users with repeated small transfers to many new addresses
indicators.canon: Transfers to many newly created crypto addresses
indicators.desc: Repeated small or fixed-amount transfers to many fresh or new crypto addresses.
indicators.ctx: Frequent low-value outbound transfers to different external wallets after small incoming crowd-sourced payments.
indicators.fp: Tipping, gaming and DeFi use produce similar patterns.

indicators.name: Use of privacy coins or mixing services with higher-risk geographies
indicators.canon: Use of mixers, chain-hopping or privacy coins
indicators.desc: Funds are moved through mixers, privacy coins or rapid cross-chain conversion to obscure origin.
indicators.ctx: Conversion to privacy-enhanced assets or routing through mixers, paired with geographic indicators.
indicators.fp: Privacy preference is lawful for many users.

indicators.name: Customer location inconsistent with declared residence
indicators.canon: Customer location inconsistent with declared residence
indicators.desc: IP or device signals suggest access from conflict-adjacent regions while KYC indicates elsewhere.
indicators.ctx: IP or device signals suggest access from conflict-adjacent regions while KYC indicates elsewhere.
indicators.fp: Travel, expatriates and VPNs cause mismatches.

indicators.name: Solicitation of donations via social channels using addresses linked to extremist content
indicators.canon: Solicitation of donations via social channels using addresses linked to extremist content
indicators.desc: Publicly advertised wallet addresses appear in extremist channels or campaigns.
indicators.ctx: Publicly advertised wallet addresses appear in extremist channels or campaigns.

indicators.name: Rapid conversion of donations to stablecoins then off-ramp through peer-to-peer channels
indicators.canon: Rapid conversion of donations to stablecoins then off-ramp through peer-to-peer channels
indicators.desc: Funds are converted and cashed out using unregulated peer-to-peer exchanges.
indicators.ctx: Funds are converted and cashed out using unregulated peer-to-peer exchanges.
indicators.fp: P2P trading is a common legitimate on-ramp in some regions.

indicators.name: Onboarding with weak identity evidence and shared devices
indicators.canon: Inconsistent or synthetic identity data at onboarding
indicators.desc: Identity documents, contact details, geolocation or device data do not align, suggesting fabricated, stolen or misrepresented identity.
indicators.ctx: Multiple accounts opened with synthetic or inconsistent identity data from common devices.
indicators.fp: Households and shared devices are common.

indicators.name: Sudden large inflows from newly funded unhosted wallets
indicators.canon: Sudden large inflows from newly funded unhosted wallets
indicators.desc: Large first deposits from unhosted wallets with no history, followed by immediate transfers out.
indicators.ctx: Large first deposits from unhosted wallets with no history, followed by immediate transfers out.
indicators.fp: Users migrating between platforms behave this way.
